# Rose Red

Rose Red is a dark theme built on a red gradient that colours the editor, panes and UI in crimson tones. It states readable contrast for low-light use and compatibility with Obsidian v1.4.13 and later.

![Rose Red screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tu2-atmanand/RoseRed-ObsidianTheme/HEAD/Thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Rose Red"
    author: "Atmanand Gauns"
    repo:   "tu2-atmanand/RoseRed-ObsidianTheme"
    slug:   "rose-red"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/rose-red"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/tu2-atmanand/RoseRed-ObsidianTheme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tu2-atmanand/RoseRed-ObsidianTheme/HEAD/Thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a red-gradient dark theme to Obsidian to style the editor, panes, and UI with cohesive crimson tones. Provide readable contrast for low-light use and compatibility with Obsidian v1.4.13 and later."
}
```
